claims.title: Canonical and constructed metric separation with two heat scales
claims.status: proved from the pinned NG20-NG21 theorem and the stated GF construction
claims.statement: On the fixed cyclic algebra and the stated canonical cutoff sequences, liminf d/(q log(q/k)) >= 2 and log(kappa)/log(q/k) tends to positive infinity; the canonical positive heat trace at k-scale tends to zero while the constructed trace tends to the explicit error-function product.
hypotheses: The same complete divisor h and source measure as NG1 are fixed.
The quartet is stipulated as 1/2 plus or minus delta plus or minus i gamma, with 0 < delta < 1/2, gamma > 2, and fixed multiplicity.
The cutoff sequence is one covered by NG20, including its separately stated s=0 cases.
NG20-NG21 are used at the exact provider version recorded in SOURCE_LEDGER.md.
limitations: No off-line zeta zero is constructed or asserted.
No conclusion about the Riemann hypothesis is drawn.
The finite checker does not certify the asymptotic provider theorem.

claims.title: Exact mixed-source minimum, determinant allocation, and certified range inverse
claims.statement: The joint metric is G_J = G^(1/2)(I+T)^(-1)G^(1/2); its total determinant decrease splits exactly into observed and old-kernel terms through the full Schur complement. For mu = lambda_min^+(H_Z), every certified 0 < underline_lambda <= mu gives the JS10-JS11 regularization bounds, and mu is bounded below by pdet(H_Z)/(tr H_Z)^(r_Z-1).
hypotheses: C has finite dimension q, J and Lambda are onto, and K = ker Lambda.
The supplied section is a genuine right inverse of the ambient value map.
ker H_Z is contained in ker F.
The polynomial realization is faithful and preserves the degree of nonzero P(S_1+...+S_k).
limitations: The physical-normal rank does not determine rank F or a determinant gain.
The original cross Gram, observation orientation, and native moments remain inputs.
An arbitrary certified eigenvalue floor is not asserted to dominate the determinant-trace floor.

claims.title: ES-labelled common reducing space and centre-length covariance
claims.status: finite proof on the generated cyclic top-chain sector
claims.statement: The labelled local translations give an exact algebra isomorphism; the two transported actions generate the direct sum indexed by distinct triples (kappa, theta, D). The adjoint ES leakage Gram is tridiagonal with the exact centre-length covariance. For the equal-multiplicity witness model, dim W_joint = (D+1) binomial(k+3,3), rank L_E = (D+1)(k-1)^2 for k >= 2, and dim ker L_E = 4k(D+1).
hypotheses: The label-to-centre bijection is chosen and retained.
ER7 is restricted to the generated top-chain sector; it is not an ambient tensor projector.
The equal-multiplicity formulas start from a sorted positive integral ES witness satisfying 4/p = 1/x + 1/y + 1/z.
The programme application has 0 < delta < 1/2, gamma > 2, k odd, and k congruent to 1 modulo 4.
ER13 uses k >= 2; the k = 1 boundary is stated separately.
limitations: This does not identify ES denominators with zeta zeros.
This does not construct an ES witness at an unoccupied prime.
No typed identification with the trace-rigidity kernel is made.

claims.title: Complete two-centre collision exponent diagram
claims.status: all-length proof with exact bounded certificate cases
claims.statement: For e >= f >= 1 and eta = |z|^a, every singular exponent is given by CP2 for 0 <= a <= 1 and CP3 for a >= 1. At a = 1 the list is 0,1,...,e+f-1. CP9-CP11 determine every inverse-exterior exponent and finite balanced-scale constants.
hypotheses: The input metric is fixed and uniformly equivalent to the standard power-coordinate metric.
After row powers are extracted, the residual target metric is uniformly positive and uniformly bounded.
Fixed jet weights act through their exact row square-root factors.
Changed input coordinates are controlled at rank r by the corresponding exterior norms.
limitations: A degenerating physical metric or section multiplier must be restored explicitly.
The finite checker covers bounded lengths and rational scale exponents; the general theorem rests on the written minor proof.

No identification of the Family C kernels with the trace-rigidity kernel.
